The '''Zabian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The amusement park [[Hologram Fun World]] was located in a helium gas cloud near the Zabian star system. After losing [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] in a rigged [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] left [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and went there.<ref name="QotE">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>
